transcript: This is the ancient drink that clears the sugar from your veins and restores the flow of life through your body, without the burden of pills. First, take one generous spoon of rosemary, fresh or dried. It awakens the blood, helps insulin move freely, and lowers glucose. Then add a small piece of turmeric, golden like the morning sun. It softens the pressure in your veins and brings balance to your heart. Next, two sticks of cinnamon. This humble spice helps your body remember how to control its sugar, naturally, without force. Boil them all in two cups of water for about nine minutes. When you drink it, you are not just taking herbs. You are drinking harmony, the wisdom of nature itself. Do this often, and you will feel your circulation awaken again. The body remembers how to heal, once you give it what it truly needs. If you wish to learn more ancient ways to heal your body, read my ebook, Healing the Modern Body. You will find it in the link on my profile. And if you are from the US or any Western country, comment down below, so I know where my people of healing are listening from.
